question: What worlds are described in kala and in the transition to maya?
premises: In kala there is the supreme world of the triad of great gods.
Maya is described as threefold and chiefly filled with endless ten-millions.
inference: Kala contains the supreme world of three great gods, and above it maya opens as a vast threefold domain.
uncertainties: The referent of the endless ten-millions is not explicitly named in this verse.
plain_english: In kala is the supreme world of the three great gods. Beyond that is maya, a threefold domain filled chiefly with countless millions.
